cards.intuition: Users feel the sum of rewrite, retrieval, rerank, and time-to-first-token as dead waiting time; streaming only hides the decode that follows.
cards.formula: total = rewrite + retrieve + rerank + TTFT + decode
cards.topic: The RAG Latency Budget: Retrieve, Rerank, Generate

cards.intuition: Long answers cost output tokens times per-token latency, so caps, concision, streaming, and small-model routing are the controls.
cards.formula: decode = output tokens x per-token latency
cards.topic: The RAG Latency Budget: Retrieve, Rerank, Generate

cards.intuition: Every stage gets a timeout and an evaluated degraded mode, so one slow dependency never sinks the whole request.
cards.formula: reranker timeout -> fused order; model timeout -> retry once
cards.topic: The RAG Latency Budget: Retrieve, Rerank, Generate

cards.intuition: Embedding caches save a call, result caches save the pre-generation block, answer caches save everything and risk the most.
cards.formula: embedding -> result -> answer: rising savings, rising liability

cards.intuition: Every key carries the versions that can invalidate it: model, index generation, ACL epoch, prompt. Missing one means silent staleness or a leak.
cards.formula: key = query + model + index gen + tenant/ACL + prompt

cards.intuition: Caching by similarity answers questions that are merely similar, not equal; the Team plan is not the Enterprise plan, however close the vectors.
cards.formula: similar is not equal: high threshold, low stakes only

cards.intuition: Long context pays corpus-sized input on every query; retrieval pays the corpus once at ingest and sends only focused tokens.
cards.formula: stuffing: corpus tokens x QPS, retrieval: few k tokens x QPS
cards.topic: Long Context vs Retrieval: Cost and Quality Tradeoffs

cards.intuition: More context is more noise to attend over, and the middle of long contexts is used worst; fewer, better chunks beat bigger prompts.
cards.formula: lost in the middle: recall degrades as context grows
cards.topic: Long Context vs Retrieval: Cost and Quality Tradeoffs

cards.intuition: Whole-corpus synthesis, corpora that fit the window, and batch jobs favor stuffing; interactive point lookups over big corpora favor retrieval.
cards.formula: synthesis -> stuff, lookup at scale -> retrieve
cards.topic: Long Context vs Retrieval: Cost and Quality Tradeoffs

cards.intuition: Bigger windows change where stuffing becomes affordable, but paying to attend to mostly noise stays wasteful at any window size.
cards.formula: windows move the break-even, not the principle
cards.topic: Long Context vs Retrieval: Cost and Quality Tradeoffs
